About WHY RACING EVENTS | PNW Race Production Team Skip to main content Home Races Training Volunteer Give Back Community Travel Sponsors About Corporate Wellness Find My Race Home Races Training Volunteer Give Back Community Travel Sponsors About Corporate Wellness Find Your Race THE STORY OF PNW RACING: WHY. A community built on fitness, family, and fun, raising millions for causes that matter. Proud Partners $3,000,000+ Donated to Charity 50,000+ Athletes Served 21 Annual Events 2014 Year Founded What's Your WHY? Some of us race to get faster and stronger. Some to get healthy and fit. Some to lose weight. Others just to get to the finish line. Some of us race because of how it makes us feel. Some to have fun and hang with our friends. Some race to give back to an important local charity. "Regardless of your WHY, we are all united on a mission to improve our own health while improving the lives of those in need." That's the philosophy behind WHY RACING EVENTS. Since 2014, we've been bringing the Pacific Northwest community together through endurance events that celebrate every athlete, from first-timers to seasoned competitors. Meet The Team The passionate people behind every finish line. Karissa & Rod Schoene Owners & Race Directors My WHY: To keep up with our kids; To teach our kids to be good humans; To enjoy all life has to offer... Read full story We approach each WHY RACING EVENT as a challenge to give our athletes an experience that they can’t wait to tell their friends and family about and they can’t wait to come back and do it again! With the amazing WHY RACING EVENTS team, it is my goal to make sure our athletes feel the WHY LOVE that we all provide. Having grown up in the Northwest, we are entrenched in this community allowing me the ability to provide an experience that our athletes have come to expect from WHY RACING EVENTS. We love to be part of a team that strives to provide the best racing experience for our athletes. It is a family affair. We can’t do this without our family around us. From our kids, to my family and friends who have volun-TOLDED, to our sponsors, vendors, volunteers and athletes, our “WHY” is because we love the people! Karissa@whyracingevents.com Brock Schoene Race Director My WHY: To promote and encourage getting outdoors and doing challenging things with family, friends, and members of the community. Read full story I grew up at WHY RACING EVENTS and love the atmosphere of our event venues. I am so excited to be part of making the athlete experience as amazing as possible. WHY provides so many opportunities to connect with our community, supporting local beneficiaries at each event, I take pride in connecting our local volunteers to our athletes. My goal is to assist our volunteers so they can be the best support crew ever and have so much fun that they want to volunteer at our events all the time. Brock@whyracingevents.com Jesse Green Operations Read full story Jesse keeps race day running smoothly behind the scenes. Full bio coming soon. Marla Stone Volunteer Coordinator My WHY: To encourage others to test their limits and to enjoy what every day has to offer. To be an example... Read full story I began trail running in my 30’s and drifted to triathlons when I “grew up.” My love for being in the outdoors in a variety of conditions and sports culminated in beginning to work for WHY RACING EVENTS. My joy is to assist in creating the best event experience for athletes of all skill levels. It is not always winning the race but completion or improving racing times from prior events. WHY RACING EVENTS strives to provide an amazing racing experience while simultaneously raising money and awareness for our beneficiaries’ causes. The WHY Family is a reality – we care about you, the athlete, and the community around you. Marla@whyracingevents.com Jim Mitts Swim Course Manager My WHY: To have fun while being involved in the running community. Read full story I have always been involved in running. It started in grade school when I participated in AAU Junior Olympics and continued through High school. I also participated in various indoor and outdoor sports throughout my adult life. I got more involved in road races and found WHY RACING EVENTS to be a great race experience and eventually started working with them in 2021. I truly love seeing race participants competing but especially in our multi sport events. jlmitts55@gmail.com Fitness We believe in the transformative power of movement. Every event is designed to help you become your best self. Family Racing is better together. We create events where families train, compete, and celebrate as one. Fun From costume contests to live bands to epic after-parties, we make every finish line a celebration. Making a Difference We are proud to partner with local non-profits across the Northwest, raising millions to support our community. Join us in racing with a purpose. See Our Impact Proud Partners WHY RACING EVENTS "What's your WHY? Find it on the course." At WHY RACING EVENTS, we believe in the power of movement to change lives. Our events have raised millions for local non-profits, schools, and community programs. Proud Partners 3 M+ Total Raised 50 + Local Beneficiaries 2014 Giving Back Since Our Mission Every WHY RACING EVENTS is partnered with one or more local beneficiaries. We provide a platform for non-profits to raise awareness and funds, ensuring that the energy generated on race day fuels positive change in our community long after the finish line. Whether it's supporting adolescent mental health, feeding local families, or funding cancer research, your participation makes a direct impact. NW Battle Buddies Making a Difference Every WHY RACING EVENTS registration supports local causes, ensuring our community grows stronger together. Proudly partnering with non-profits across the Pacific Northwest. Northwest Battle Buddies Police Activities League Ainsley's Angels of America Vancouver Public Schools Pink Lemonade Project Clark County Food Bank South Pacific County Humane Society Autism Society of Oregon Washington Trails Association Washougal Schools Foundation Foundation for Vancouver Public Schools WHY Community NW Association for Blind Athletes Trail Keepers of Oregon La Center HS Volleyball & Track South Wasco County School District Special Olympics NSF National Scleroderma Foundation South Pacific County Humane Society ESDF Evergreen School District Foundation FOV Friends of Fort Vancouver Local Sports & Programs Road + Trail: A Spectrum of Support Different terrains, same heart. Every race type serves a unique purpose in our community. Road Racing Our road events often benefit large-scale community initiatives, local school districts, and city-wide health programs. They bring thousands together in the heart of our community. Trail & Nature Our trail events help preserve local parks, support forest conservation, and fund outdoor youth education programs. We race in nature to protect nature. Ready to Make an Impact? Join thousands of athletes who race with purpose. Every registration, every mile, every finish line celebration contributes to something bigger. Find Your Race WHY RACING EVENTS "What's your WHY? Find it on the course." PNW Race Volunteer Opportunities | WHY RACING EVENTS Skip to main content Home Races Training Volunteer Give Back Community Travel Sponsors About Corporate Wellness Find My Race Home Races Training Volunteer Give Back Community Travel Sponsors About Corporate Wellness Find Your Race PNW Race Volunteer Opportunities: Be Part of the Spirit. Our volunteers are the heartbeat of every WHY RACING EVENT. Join our crew, support amazing athletes, and experience the energy of race day from the inside. Why Volunteer? More than just race day support, it's a community experience that changes lives, starting with yours. Join the Community Meet passionate people and make lifelong friends while supporting the local PNW racing scene. Our volunteer crew is a family. Earn Perks Get a limited edition volunteer shirt, snacks, and "crew credit" towards future race entries. Our way of saying thank you. Make an Impact Your encouragement at a water station or course turn can be the difference for an athlete's biggest day. You'll feel it too. Volunteer Roles From the finish line to the far reaches of the course, we have a spot for you. Course Marshal Keep athletes safe and on track at key intersections. High energy and loud cheering required! Registration Be the first friendly face athletes see. Help with bib pickup and gear bags. Aid Stations The literal life-savers. Hand out water, electrolytes, and endless motivation. Finish Line Crew Place medals around necks and celebrate the incredible achievements of every finisher. Ready to Volunteer? Behind every personal record, every emotional finish, and every first-timer crossing the line, there's a volunteer who made it possible.
